analysis_kind: Read-only independent retention/hardware audit of supplied second-host evidence
warnings: retention-100000-occ_list_map-enabled: reversed calendar timestamps; no retention duration is inferred

plan_serialization.explanation: The wrapper verifies the original CRLF plan bytes and then writes a normalized LF JSON snapshot. Its byte hash differs; its parsed specifications are identical.

wrapper_review.behavior: Selects the exact 30 existing retention jobs; verifies their source manifest and sources; invokes unchanged worker_main in blocking subprocess.run calls; preserves stdout/stderr/return codes, exact specs and before/after source pins.
wrapper_review.no_pointer_detachment_scope: The four occurrence arms only remove exhausted map entries and/or replace occurrence rank buckets; no skip-list pointer detachment. The grouped compact reference retains its existing combined detachment policy.
wrapper_review.validation_scope: Shipped preflight/gate files remain first-host evidence. Reusing worker_main does not constitute a fresh full-workload phase-three gate. New retention workers validate every extraction locally.
wrapper_review.limits: Source equality and raw-record consistency are verified; this audit does not observe historical execution directly or prove exclusion of all background processes.

hardware.physical_host_evidence: User-identified second physical laptop, supported by distinct Windows/WSL hardware records; not merely a container on the original Mac.
hardware.windows_name_note: Legacy registry ProductName says Windows 10 Pro; build/display metadata and handoff identify Windows 11 Pro 25H2. Retain the discrepancy instead of silently treating ProductName as current branding.

limits: Windows/WSL virtualization, CPython version and compiler differ from Mac, so host effects are not isolated hardware effects.
No CPU pinning, frequency/thermal control, continuous power trace or exclusive-machine guarantee.
No cgroup CPU/memory quota observed; WSL still exposes only its VM-visible memory, not all installed RAM.
Zero swap use at snapshots does not prove no transient paging during measurements.

chronology.interpretation: Stage shell scripts and wrappers use blocking calls and record consecutive ordinals. Native lifecycle timestamps are internally ordered. One retention worker has reversed calendar labels, consistent with a calendar-clock discontinuity; retention ordering therefore rests on blocking wrapper calls and ordinal/record consistency, not UTC durations. The post-run handshake also shows a Windows/WSL calendar offset. Algorithm duration clocks are monotonic/process clocks; retention measurements are allocation snapshots, not duration benchmarks.
chronology.limits: The records substantiate ordering of these study jobs, not absence of all background OS/user processes. Calendar lifecycle times are not algorithm runtimes.

interpretation: This is a second-physical-host repetition of the 30 bounded-live Python retention cells, not a rerun of Python graph timings or graph-memory ablations.
The history-retaining maps contain N entries after drain; map-cleaned and compact maps contain zero. Both hosts return every expected key and have no live level-zero entries after drain.
Report bytes and within-host ratios descriptively; each method/length/GC cell has one process, not repeated samples supporting a confidence interval.
Absolute cross-host allocation differences cannot be assigned to hardware: CPython 3.13 versus 3.12, OS, allocator and runtime layout also differ.

Extracted skip-list node pointers are not detached in the four occurrence arms; the compact reference is explicitly coupled. Linked occurrence-bucket entries have their own separate link-removal bookkeeping.
Zero explicit-GC collected objects means before/after-GC byte differences are not evidence of reclaimed cycles; interpreter free-list effects can also change traced bytes.
The first-host phase-three full-workload trace gate is preserved evidence, not newly executed second-host validation; each new retention worker checks every expected extraction.
No constant-space theorem, process-RSS reduction, general predictor benefit, or cross-host Python query-time result follows from these retention measurements.
